# Maria

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Maria is characterized by a compulsive tendency to laugh at everything, regardless of how tragic or serious the situation might be. She possesses a strong desire to travel, specifically expressing intentions to visit [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) and Egypt.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Ezra P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006), [v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008)_

## History

Maria lived at Tabby's Place with her aunt, Miss Tabby Linden, and regarded [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) Linden as a good uncle. Together with her aunt, she successfully arranged to rent their cottage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P27](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0027), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Relationships

### [Tabby](../character/tabby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--tabby.md)

Maria is the niece of Miss Tabby Linden, with whom she lives and manages Tabby's Place. The two act as traveling companions staying overseas together and prepare to journey to Egypt. They also arrange to rent out their cottage to students, including [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), for the school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), +2 more_
